from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to filtering."""
    title: Optional[str] = Field(description="The title or caption of the judgment document as found in the text")
    cause_of_action: Optional[str] = Field(description="The specific cause of action explicitly stated in the document (e.g., '侵害发明专利权纠纷', '行政赔偿')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[LegalDocument]
